remarks: Tucked away in a prime Westport location, this boutique turnkey property offers effortless luxury, exceptional comfort, and refined coastal living. Newly constructed and beautifully furnished with pristine white furnishings, the home exudes a fresh, sophisticated aesthetic throughout. Vaulted, beamed ceilings create an open and airy atmosphere, while crisp interiors, warm area rugs, curated artwork, and designer details lend an inviting yet elevated feel.The sun-drenched Great Room flows seamlessly into a stylish eat-in kitchen featuring a generous dining table that doubles as an island, handsome accent lighting, abundant storage, and new appliances. Sliding doors open to a huge private, FULLY FENCED, DOG FRIENDLY backyard oasis-perfect for relaxing, al fresco dining, summer entertaining, or simply unwinding in complete privacy.The spacious bedroom suite serves as a serene retreat with a beautifully appointed bath and walk-in shower. Thoughtful amenities, including a stacked washer/dryer, wall-mounted televisions, outdoor grill, and private exterior storage for bicycles or kayaks make everyday living effortless. Separate parking for two cars, plus guest parking, adds to the home's convenience.Just minutes from downtown Westport's renowned shopping, dining, beaches, Longshore Club, YMCA, & major commuting routes, this sophisticated cottage offers the perfect blend of style, comfort, privacy, & convenience. Move right in and enjoy all this exceptional property has to offer
